corrections.defect: Runner used read-only rootfs + no volumes while commands run under /stage, so staged source could not reach a writable /stage.
corrections.fix: Added bounded writable tmpfs /stage (rw, uid/gid 1000, mode 755, size 2g) and a bounded writable HOME tmpfs /home/box (rw, uid/gid 1000, mode 755, size 64m) plus HOME=/home/box env, in both manifest runner config and runnerCreateArgv. Read-only rootfs, capDrop ALL, no-new-privileges, no volumes/host mounts and fixed argv preserved. New stageCopyArgv(stageRoot) emits the fixed ['cp','<stageRoot>/.','w005-d12-delegation-runner:/stage'] host-side copy into the tmpfs, and manifest stage.delivery documents this bounded delivery mode. Staging remains fail-closed via assertStageableRel/digest/boundary checks.
edits: environment-host.mjs runnerCreateArgv tmpfs/env, new stageCopyArgv export

corrections.defect: No actual UI/browser coverage; manifest excluded browser evidence.
corrections.fix: Added a real-browser test (delegation box preparation flow, 'collects real browser UI evidence...', ~L167-243 of preparation.test.ts): launches pinned chromium via @playwright/test with per-process --host-resolver-rules mapping only private.localhost (no global DNS, no /etc/hosts mutation, no browser install, no host browser); serves the real private console via a vite dev server on 127.0.0.1:3000 and the real private API via app.listen on 127.0.0.1:4000; seeds real session cookie + sessionStorage CSRF; drives genuine UI prepare -> agreement card -> owner approve -> amend -> reload -> reopened persisted version-2 draft/superseded state; asserts UI negatives (invalid box id failure, requester sees no approve control and the owner-only note) and a genuine browser-issued API negative (uncredentialed-csrf approve fetch returns >=400). No mocks, stubs or simulator claims. Manifest browserEvidence block documents this real-browser mode and replaces the prior exclusion note; runner env gains PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/ms-playwright.

corrections.defect: agreement() for a non-prepared box could 503 by querying repo_id=undefined.
corrections.fix: BoxStore.readPrepared now guards: the repository query only runs when head.version_payload.repoId is a string; otherwise repository=null and orchestrator.agreement returns missing_evidence (422).

corrections.defect: Projection facts claimed assurance 'tested' before any execution.
corrections.fix: Projection now emits assurance 'unverified' (allowed by BoxAgreementProjectionSchema), truthful about pre-execution status.
